question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Chemistry department (Course 5) and the Political Science department), provide the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the full name of the corresponding administrative department, and, for each term in which the department offered subjects in 2016, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in that term and that are offered this year. For each department, also include a grand total for all terms in the format of (department name, ..., null, total units stats). List the results in order by department name and term. Do not return any rounded answers.

access_trace.sql:
WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range,
    VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7')
  GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
),
term_unit_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    ccs.TERM_CODE,
    AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    MAX(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range,
    VARIANCE(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7')
    AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2016'
    AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ccs.TERM_CODE
),
grand_total_unit_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    NULL AS TERM_CODE,
    AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    MAX(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range,
    VARIANCE(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7')
    AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2016'
    AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
),
admin_dept AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_dept_full_name
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_name,
  t.TERM_CODE,
  e.enrolled_range,
  e.enrolled_variance,
  a.admin_dept_full_name,
  t.avg_total_units,
  t.total_units_range,
  t.total_units_variance
FROM (
  SELECT
    t.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    t.TERM_CODE,
    t.avg_total_units,
    t.total_units_range,
    t.total_units_variance
  FROM term_unit_stats t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    g.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    g.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    g.TERM_CODE,
    g.avg_total_units,
    g.total_units_range,
    g.total_units_variance
  FROM grand_total_unit_stats g
) t
JOIN dept_enrollment_stats e ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN admin_dept a ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t.TERM_CODE

WITH
deg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT
  WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5','17')
),
enr AS (
  SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY
  WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
),
enr_stats AS (
  SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
         MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enr_range,
         VAR_SAMP(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enr_var
  FROM enr
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
off2016 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '2016%'
),
thisyear AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE CONCAT((SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS), '%')
),
units AS (
  SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s.TERM_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
  JOIN thisyear t ON t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2016%'
    AND s.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
),
term_stats AS (
  SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE,
         AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS u_avg,
         MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS u_range,
         VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS u_var
  FROM units
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE
),
grand_stats AS (
  SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
         AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS u_avg,
         MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS u_range,
         VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS u_var
  FROM units
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       e.enr_range,
       e.enr_var,
       d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
       o.TERM_CODE,
       ts.u_avg,
       ts.u_range,
       ts.u_var
FROM deg d
LEFT JOIN enr_stats e ON e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN off2016 o ON o.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN term_stats ts ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ts.TERM_CODE = o.TERM_CODE
UNION ALL
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       e.enr_range,
       e.enr_var,
       d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
       NULL,
       g.u_avg,
       g.u_range,
       g.u_var
FROM deg d
LEFT JOIN enr_stats e ON e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN grand_stats g ON g.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY 1, 5;
